proposals.before: He was posted as judicial aide on the Yizhou Observation Commission, then made magistrate of Lianshui County, and rose in time to Hanlin Academician.
proposals.after: He was posted as judicial aide on the Yizhou Observation Commission, then made magistrate of Laishui County, and rose in time to Hanlin Academician.
proposals.reason: 淶水 is Laishui (modern Hebei), not Lianshui; the place-name romanization is wrong.

proposals.before: He was assigned as judicial aide to the Yizhou Observation Commission, then transferred to magistrate of Lianshui County, and was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academician.
proposals.after: He was assigned as judicial aide to the Yizhou Observation Commission, then transferred to magistrate of Laishui County, and was repeatedly promoted to Hanlin Academician.
proposals.reason: 淶水 should be Laishui, matching the Chinese toponym.

proposals.before: He was made Commissioner of Guozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
proposals.after: He was made Commissioner of Gaozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
proposals.reason: 高州 is Gaozhou, not Guozhou; mistranslation of the place name.

proposals.before: He was transferred to Commissioner of Guozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
proposals.after: He was transferred to Commissioner of Gaozhou for Observation, built schools, and enrolled students.
proposals.reason: 高州 must be Gaozhou in the literal rendering as well.

decisions.reason: s0009 改淶水縣令 names Laishui County (淶水); Lianshui is a different place (漣水). The proposed Laishui corrects the romanization without other changes.
The literal line likewise renders 淶水 as Lianshui; Laishui matches the Chinese toponym.
s0096 改高州觀察使 is Gaozhou Observation Commissioner; Guozhou misreads 高. The proposed Gaozhou is correct.
The literal English also has Guozhou for 高州; Gaozhou is the accurate reading.
